chunks: What Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Abu Ja'far, from al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, that he said:
The one suffering from an abdominal illness and the one with a fracture are to have tawaf performed on their behalf, and ramy is done on their behalf.

key_terms.الْكَسِيرُ: a person suffering from a fracture or severe physical injury
key_terms.الْمَبْطُونُ: a person afflicted with an abdominal illness
key_terms.عَنْهُمَا: on behalf of the two of them

ai.seo_question: Can tawaf and ramy be performed on behalf of a sick or injured pilgrim?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for pilgrims who are physically unable to perform certain rites due to illness or injury. It states that tawaf and ramy may be carried out on behalf of such persons, indicating facilitation in hajj rites for the incapacitated.
